Agencies Military OneSource does not publish per installation — command post, mental health, chaplain, SARC, security forces, finance, MPF, EO — are present but empty, and the toolkit falls back to Military OneSource for those.

contacts.name: Region Legal Service Office Western Pacific Detachment Hawaii (RLSO WESTPAC Det HI) - Legal Assistance Department
contacts.location: 850 Willamette Street Building 1746, Second Floor JBPHH, HI 96860-5109
contacts.notes: Thank you for contacting the Legal Assistance Department at Region Legal Service Office Western Pacific Detachment Hawai'i (RLSO WESTPAC Det HI). We have walk-in hours for notaries and Special Powers of Attorney (SPOAs) on Mondays from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. and on Wednesdays from 10:00 a.m.to 12:00 p.m.. We have new client walk-in hours for attorney services for active duty servicemembers and their dependents on Tuesdays from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m..
